The **.44 Pistol** is a non-automatic pistol in *Fallout 76*.

A double-action revolver with a blued finish and wooden grips. Inscribed along the Long Barrel is ".44 Magnum." These firearms boast considerable ballistic damage, strong recoil, and are readily accessible in the wasteland. Regardless of its full range of capabilities, the weapon will only ever be fired in single action, with the hammer manually pulled back before each shot.
